# Despia Local

The on-device data plane: SQLite with vectors, snapshots and typed access, for
iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux. Apache-2.0. A real local database with
zero AI involved, and the substrate the agentic write guarantee stands on.

## Docs

- docs/data-plane.md: stores, values, queries, and the type vocabulary
- docs/snapshots.md: savepoints versus snapshots, restore, and the agent guarantee
- docs/vectors.md: vector indexes and why every entry records its embedding
- docs/conformance.md: running the vendored fixture corpus
